title: [ingest] Loop hard-cap defaults that bound autonomous token burn
summary: A new heartbeat loop ships with config { tokenBudget: 100000, maxIterations: 200, minPoll: 30, maxPoll: 1200, estPerTick: 800, batch: 8 }. These are the runaway backstops; exceeding tokenBudget or maxIterations stops the loop. Persisted to disk so a restart keeps the caps.
